lessons.title: Health
lessons.learn_line: What health is, why it is essential, and the habits that keep us healthy in body and mind.
warmup: How often do you wash your hands, and why?
What does the proverb 'Health is Wealth' mean to you?
Do you go to bed early and rise early? How does it make you feel?
Can a wealthy person be unhappy if they are not healthy?

reading.summary_en: Health is the condition of our body and mind, and it may be good or bad. Good health means a healthy body that is free from diseases, and it is essential for everyone to lead a happy life. If we are not in good health, we cannot concentrate on any activity. A proverb says 'Health is Wealth', meaning health is as valuable as gold or any other possession; we may have great wealth, but if we are not healthy we cannot enjoy it. To stay healthy we must take a balanced diet, exercise regularly, follow the saying 'early to bed and early to rise', and keep peace of mind by not worrying over small things.
reading.gist_bn: স্বাস্থ্য হলো আমাদের দেহ ও মনের অবস্থা, যা ভালো বা খারাপ হতে পারে। সুস্বাস্থ্য মানে রোগমুক্ত সুস্থ দেহ, যা সুখী জীবনযাপনের জন্য অপরিহার্য। অসুস্থ হলে কোনো কাজে মন বসানো যায় না। 'Health is Wealth' প্রবাদটি বোঝায় স্বাস্থ্য সোনা বা যেকোনো সম্পদের মতোই মূল্যবান। সুস্থ থাকতে হলে সুষম খাবার, নিয়মিত ব্যায়াম, রাত জেগে না থেকে তাড়াতাড়ি ঘুমানো ও ভোরে ওঠা এবং মানসিক শান্তি প্রয়োজন।

short_answers.q: Why is good health essential for us?

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph on 'How to Maintain Good Health' (about 180-200 words).
writing.model: Good health is the greatest blessing in life, for without it nothing else can be enjoyed. Health is the condition of both our body and mind, and to keep it good we must follow some simple rules every day. First, we should take a balanced diet that contains the right amount of carbohydrate, protein, fat, vitamins and minerals, and we must avoid overeating. Secondly, we should do regular physical exercise, such as walking, swimming or freehand exercises, because it keeps the body fit, gives us energy and makes us strong and cheerful. We should also follow the old saying, 'Early to bed and early to rise, makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise', so we must not keep late hours but sleep enough at night and rise early in the morning. Cleanliness is equally important; we should keep our body, clothes and surroundings clean to stay free from germs and disease. Finally, we need peace of mind, so we should not worry over small things of life. If we follow all these rules properly, we will be able to lead a healthy, active and happy life.

lessons.title: Ode on Solitude
lessons.learn_line: What a truly happy, peaceful life looks like, according to the poet Alexander Pope.
warmup: What do you think makes a person truly happy?
Is a quiet, simple life better than a busy, famous one? Why?
What does the word 'content' mean to you?
Would you rather be rich and busy, or simple and peaceful?

reading.theme: The happiness and peace of a simple, contented country life.
reading.central_idea: In this poem, Alexander Pope describes a happy man as one who is content to live quietly on his own small piece of land (a few paternal acres), breathing his native air. Such a man's own herds, fields and trees give him milk, bread, clothing and shade. He passes his time in good health, peace of mind, sound sleep, study, recreation and innocent meditation. He wishes to live unseen and unknown, and to die quietly, leaving the world without even a stone to mark where he lies. The poem praises a simple, self-sufficient, peaceful life over wealth and fame.
reading.gist_bn: আলেকজান্ডার পোপের এই কবিতায় সুখী মানুষ সেই, যে নিজের সামান্য পৈতৃক জমিতে নিজের আকাশের বাতাসে সন্তুষ্ট থেকে বাস করে। তার নিজের গবাদি পশু, ক্ষেত ও গাছ তাকে দুধ, খাদ্য, পোশাক ও ছায়া দেয়। সুস্বাস্থ্য, মনের শান্তি, গভীর ঘুম, পড়াশোনা, নির্দোষ আনন্দ ও ধ্যানের মধ্য দিয়ে তার দিন কাটে। সে চায় লোকচক্ষুর আড়ালে, অখ্যাত থেকে বাঁচতে ও শান্তিতে মরতে। কবিতাটি ধন-যশের চেয়ে সরল, স্বনির্ভর ও শান্তিময় জীবনকে শ্রেষ্ঠ বলে।

qa.q: What things does a happy man have, according to the poem?
qa.model: According to the poem, a happy man has a few acres of his father's land, his own herds for milk, fields for bread, flocks for clothing, and trees that give him shade in summer and firewood in winter. In short, his own land supplies all his simple needs.

qa.q: How does the happy man pass his time?
qa.model: He passes his time peacefully, in good health and peace of mind. His days are quiet, his nights bring sound sleep, and he mixes study with ease, sweet recreation and innocent meditation.

qa.q: How does the happy man wish to die?
qa.model: He wishes to live unseen and unknown, and to die quietly and unlamented. He wants to slip away from the world without even a stone to tell people where he lies.

qa.q: Why does the poet call this man 'happy' and 'blest'?
qa.model: The poet calls him happy and blest because he is content with little, free from worry and ambition, and self-sufficient. His simple, peaceful, healthy life is, for Pope, the truest form of happiness.

qa.q: What is the central message of the poem?
qa.model: The central message is that real happiness lies not in wealth, fame or city life, but in a simple, quiet, contented life close to nature, with good health and peace of mind.

qa.q: How does the poem connect to the theme of health?
qa.model: The poem links happiness with 'health of body, peace of mind' and 'sound sleep by night'. It suggests that a calm, simple life naturally supports good physical and mental health.

qa.q: Do you think you can be happy in life the way the poem describes? Why?
qa.model: Answers will vary. A good answer might say that being content with what we have, keeping good health and peace of mind, and not chasing endless wealth can indeed make a person genuinely happy.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph on 'A Happy Life' (about 100 words).
writing.model: A happy life does not depend on great wealth or fame, but on contentment, good health and peace of mind. A truly happy person is satisfied with what they have and does not waste their days in worry or greed. Like the man in Pope's poem, such a person enjoys simple pleasures: good food from their own work, sound sleep at night, a little study and recreation, and quiet time to think. Living close to nature and free from anxiety, they remain healthy in body and calm in mind. This simple, peaceful and innocent way of living is, in the end, the happiest life of all.

lessons.title: Hygiene
lessons.learn_line: What hygiene means and the everyday rules of cleanliness that keep us healthy.
warmup: What does the word 'hygiene' mean?
How many times should we brush our teeth a day?
What kind of water is safe to drink?
Why do dirty clothes invite germs?

reading.summary_en: The word 'hygiene' means the practice of keeping ourselves, our home and our workplaces clean, and it is important for good health. Hygiene is said to be next to godliness, because we cannot achieve anything physically, mentally or spiritually if we are unclean in body, mind and soul, and nobody likes an unclean person. To follow the rules of hygiene we must first keep our body clean by bathing every day and washing our hair regularly. Secondly, we should wash our clothes regularly, because dirty clothes give off bad smells and invite germs; we should wear socks and shoes outside, wash our hands before meals and after using the toilet, brush our teeth twice a day after breakfast and supper, and cut our nails regularly. Our drinking water must be safe, which we can ensure by boiling and filtering. Finally, we should keep our surroundings and environment clean. If we follow all these things properly, we can lead a healthy and happy life.
reading.gist_bn: 'Hygiene' শব্দের অর্থ নিজেকে, ঘর ও কর্মস্থল পরিষ্কার রাখার অভ্যাস, যা সুস্বাস্থ্যের জন্য জরুরি। পরিচ্ছন্নতা ধর্মের কাছাকাছি, কারণ শরীর-মন-আত্মায় অপরিষ্কার থাকলে দৈহিক, মানসিক বা আধ্যাত্মিক কিছুই অর্জন করা যায় না। নিয়ম: প্রতিদিন গোসল ও চুল পরিষ্কার; কাপড় নিয়মিত ধোয়া; বাইরে গেলে মোজা-জুতা পরা; খাবার আগে ও টয়লেটের পর হাত ধোয়া; দিনে দুবার দাঁত ব্রাশ; নিয়মিত নখ কাটা; ফুটিয়ে ও ছেঁকে নিরাপদ পানি পান; এবং চারপাশ পরিষ্কার রাখা।

short_answers.q: What does the word 'hygiene' mean?

writing.prompt: Make a list and write a paragraph on 'Five Things I Do Daily to Maintain Personal Hygiene' (about 100 words).
writing.model: Personal hygiene is the habit of keeping our own body clean, and I follow a few simple rules every day. First, I take a bath every morning and wash my hair regularly so that my body stays free from dirt and bacteria. Secondly, I wash my hands carefully before every meal and after using the toilet. Thirdly, I brush my teeth twice a day, once after breakfast and once after supper, and I cut my nails when they grow long. Fourthly, I always wear clean, washed clothes, because dirty clothes smell bad and invite germs. Finally, I drink only safe water that has been boiled and filtered. By doing these five things daily, I stay clean, healthy and tidy.

lessons.title: A Dialogue (At the Doctor's)
lessons.learn_line: How a patient describes symptoms to a doctor and how the doctor examines and prescribes treatment.
warmup: Have you ever visited a doctor? What did the doctor ask you?
What does a doctor use to listen to your chest?
What does it mean to 'prescribe' a medicine?
Why might a doctor advise a chest X-ray?

reading.summary_en: In this dialogue, Rabi takes his father, Mr Zahir Ali, to the doctor's clinic because his father is unwell and has difficulty speaking. Rabi tells the doctor that his father has difficulty breathing as before and is again having severe chest pain. The doctor asks Mr Ali to lie down on the examination table and presses different places, and Mr Ali feels pain. The doctor then prescribes a medicine, telling him to take one tablet in the morning and another at night before meals. The doctor also advises Mr Ali to have a chest X-ray immediately and to show the X-ray report that same evening if possible. Rabi thanks the doctor.
reading.gist_bn: এই কথোপকথনে রাবি তার অসুস্থ বাবা জনাব জহির আলীকে ডাক্তারের ক্লিনিকে নিয়ে যায়; বাবার কথা বলতে কষ্ট হচ্ছে। রাবি বলে, আগের মতোই তার শ্বাস নিতে কষ্ট হচ্ছে ও তীব্র বুকে ব্যথা হচ্ছে। ডাক্তার তাঁকে পরীক্ষা টেবিলে শুইয়ে পরীক্ষা করেন; ব্যথা অনুভব হয়। ডাক্তার ওষুধ লিখে দেন—সকালে ও রাতে খাবার আগে একটি করে ট্যাবলেট—এবং দ্রুত বুকের এক্স-রে করিয়ে সন্ধ্যায় রিপোর্ট দেখাতে বলেন।

lessons.title: A Letter (The Dangers of Smoking)
lessons.learn_line: How smoking harms health, through a real-life letter about a family's loss to lung cancer.
warmup: Do you know anyone who smokes? How do you feel about it?

reading.summary_en: In this letter, Rabi writes to his friend Sohel to share a tragedy: his father has died of lung cancer. Rabi explains that his father used to smoke heavily, having picked up the habit in his college days. Recently his father had continuous chest pain, and the doctor's chest X-ray showed dark marks on his lungs that were signs of lung cancer. The doctor explained that a poisonous substance called nicotine is in tobacco leaves, and since cigarettes are made from tobacco, this nicotine enters the lungs with every puff. Smoking for years causes deadly lung cancer. Rabi and his mother had tried hard to stop his father from smoking, but he never listened, and he died an untimely death. As the only earning member, his death has left the big family of seven broke and struggling to survive. Rabi says they are trying to recover by the grace of the Almighty.
reading.gist_bn: এই চিঠিতে রাবি তার বন্ধু সোহেলকে একটি দুঃখের খবর জানায়—তার বাবা ফুসফুসের ক্যান্সারে মারা গেছেন। বাবা কলেজজীবন থেকে অতিরিক্ত ধূমপান করতেন। এক্স-রেতে ফুসফুসে কালো দাগ ধরা পড়ে, যা ক্যান্সারের লক্ষণ। ডাক্তার বলেন, তামাক পাতায় নিকোটিন নামক বিষাক্ত উপাদান থাকে; সিগারেট তামাক থেকে তৈরি, তাই প্রতিটি টানে নিকোটিন ফুসফুসে ঢোকে এবং বছরের পর বছর ধূমপান ক্যান্সার ঘটায়। বাবা ছিলেন একমাত্র উপার্জনক্ষম ব্যক্তি; তাঁর মৃত্যুতে সাত সদস্যের পরিবার এখন নিঃস্ব।

writing.prompt: Imagine you are Sohel. Write a reply to Rabi's letter expressing your sympathy.
writing.model:
10/B College Road, Khulna
12 June 2013

Dear Rabi,

I was deeply shocked and saddened to receive your letter. Please accept my heartfelt sympathy for the loss of your dear father. It is hard to find words at such a painful time, but I want you to know that my thoughts are with you and your family.

Your letter has also opened my eyes to the terrible dangers of smoking. I never knew that the nicotine in tobacco could cause such a fatal disease as lung cancer. From now on, I will warn my own relatives and friends never to start this deadly habit.

I know these days are very difficult for your family, especially since your father was the only earning member. Please do not lose heart. Be strong for your mother and stay close to the Almighty, who will surely help you through this hard time. If I can be of any help, do not hesitate to write to me.

Give my regards to your mother. Take care of yourself.

Yours ever,
Sohel

lessons.title: Physical Exercise
lessons.learn_line: The kinds of physical exercise we can do and the many benefits they bring.
warmup: Do you do any physical exercise every day? What kind?

reading.summary_en: In this lesson, Mr Pronay Larma, the physical teacher of Rooppur High School, talks to his students about health. When he asks what is necessary for good health, a student says we need healthy food, proper rest and sleep, and to be clean and tidy. Mr Larma agrees but adds that we also need regular physical exercise. He explains that there are different kinds of exercise that can be done indoors or outdoors: at home we can do freehand exercises and stretch different parts of the body, while outside we can play, swim or simply walk. He says the benefits of physical exercise are many: the greatest is that it keeps us fit for work, and it also gives us energy, makes us strong and cheerful, and teaches us regularity and discipline.
reading.gist_bn: এই পাঠে রূপপুর হাই স্কুলের শরীরচর্চা শিক্ষক জনাব প্রণয় লারমা শিক্ষার্থীদের সঙ্গে স্বাস্থ্য নিয়ে কথা বলেন। সুস্বাস্থ্যের জন্য দরকার পুষ্টিকর খাবার, পর্যাপ্ত বিশ্রাম-ঘুম, পরিচ্ছন্নতা—এবং নিয়মিত শরীরচর্চা। ঘরের ভেতরে ফ্রি-হ্যান্ড ব্যায়াম ও স্ট্রেচিং, বাইরে খেলা, সাঁতার বা হাঁটা করা যায়। ব্যায়ামের অনেক উপকার: এটি কাজের জন্য ফিট রাখে, শক্তি দেয়, শক্তিশালী ও প্রফুল্ল করে এবং নিয়মানুবর্তিতা ও শৃঙ্খলা শেখায়।

writing.prompt: Write a paragraph on 'The Benefits of Physical Exercise' (about 100 words).
writing.model: Physical exercise is one of the most important habits for a healthy life. There are many kinds of exercise: indoor ones such as freehand exercises and stretching, and outdoor ones such as playing games, swimming and walking. The benefits of regular exercise are countless. lessons.title: A Healthy and Happy Family
lessons.learn_line: How a clean, aware and educated family stays healthy and happy in a rural home.
warmup: What does a clean, healthy home look like?

reading.summary_en: This lesson is about a healthy and happy family living in a clean rural home. The family lives in a remote area, and their tidy house and surroundings are kept free from dirt and mosquitoes. Because the parents are literate and aware of the importance of cleanliness and good health, the whole family follows healthy habits and shares in keeping the home clean. They know that an unclean environment can lead to harmful and contagious diseases, so they stay careful and keep their home neat. As a result, the family lives a healthy, happy and disease-free life. The lesson focuses on useful words such as remote, literate, delicious, aware, harmful and contagious.
reading.gist_bn: এই পাঠ একটি সুস্থ ও সুখী পরিবার নিয়ে, যারা একটি পরিচ্ছন্ন গ্রামীণ বাড়িতে বাস করে। পরিবারটি একটি প্রত্যন্ত (remote) এলাকায় থাকে; তাদের গোছানো বাড়ি ও আশপাশ ময়লা ও মশামুক্ত। বাবা-মা শিক্ষিত (literate) এবং পরিচ্ছন্নতা ও স্বাস্থ্য সম্পর্কে সচেতন (aware), তাই গোটা পরিবার স্বাস্থ্যকর অভ্যাস মেনে চলে ও ঘর পরিষ্কার রাখায় অংশ নেয়। অপরিষ্কার পরিবেশ ক্ষতিকর (harmful) ও সংক্রামক (contagious) রোগ ডেকে আনে জেনে তারা সতর্ক থাকে এবং সুস্থ-সুখী জীবনযাপন করে।

writing.model: A healthy and happy family is one that lives in a clean home and follows good habits together. Such a family keeps its house and surroundings tidy, so that the place stays free from dirt and mosquitoes. lessons.title: Making a Class Committee
lessons.learn_line: How students form a committee to keep their classroom clean and share the responsibility.
warmup: Is your classroom always clean? Who keeps it clean?
Whose responsibility is it to keep a classroom tidy?
What is a 'committee', and why might a class need one?
What ground rules would you make to keep your class clean?

reading.summary_en: In this lesson, Ms Subarna Saha, the class teacher, enters a dirty classroom and asks the students why it is so dirty. She points out that although the school cleaner is absent, the students can keep their own classroom clean, because cleaning is good physical work and it is their responsibility to keep the room clean and tidy. Shafiq, the class captain, politely agrees that they will do it from now on. The teacher suggests that they first make a forum and select a leader, then divide the cleaning activities among different groups. Shafiq likes the idea, and a committee is formed by the class 8 students under the leadership of their class captain. The students are divided into several groups, a work plan is made, and they decide on ground rules: do not spit in the classroom, do not drop litter, use the bin for trash, and keep the desks and chairs in place. All the students are very excited to be involved in this activity.
reading.gist_bn: এই পাঠে শ্রেণিশিক্ষক মিস সুবর্ণা সাহা নোংরা শ্রেণিকক্ষে ঢুকে জিজ্ঞেস করেন কেন এত নোংরা। স্কুলের পরিচ্ছন্নতাকর্মী অনুপস্থিত থাকলেও শিক্ষার্থীরা নিজেরাই নিজেদের শ্রেণিকক্ষ পরিষ্কার রাখতে পারে; এটি তাদের দায়িত্ব। শ্রেণি ক্যাপ্টেন শফিক রাজি হয়। শিক্ষক পরামর্শ দেন—প্রথমে একটি ফোরাম গঠন ও একজন নেতা নির্বাচন, তারপর বিভিন্ন দলে কাজ ভাগ করে দেওয়া। ক্যাপ্টেনের নেতৃত্বে কমিটি গঠিত হয় এবং কিছু নিয়ম ঠিক হয়: শ্রেণিকক্ষে থুতু না ফেলা, আবর্জনা না ফেলা, ময়লা বিনে ফেলা, ডেস্ক-চেয়ার ঠিক জায়গায় রাখা।

writing.prompt: Write a paragraph on 'Keeping Our Classroom Clean' (about 100 words).
writing.model: Keeping our classroom clean is the responsibility of every student, not just the school cleaner. A clean, tidy classroom creates a pleasant environment in which we can study with a fresh mind. To keep it clean, our class can form a small committee under the leadership of the class captain and divide the cleaning duties among different groups. We should also follow some simple ground rules: never spit on the floor, never drop litter, always use the bin for trash, and keep the desks and chairs in their proper places. When everyone shares the work and follows these rules, our classroom stays neat, healthy and welcoming for all.
